# `effectMapFlatten`

Suggests using Effect.flatMap instead of Effect.map followed by Effect.flatten in piping flows

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | No |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377086` |
| Language Service name | `effectMapFlatten` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/effect-map-flatten` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

export const preview = Effect.succeed(1).pipe(
  Effect.map((n) => Effect.succeed(n + 1)),
  Effect.flatten
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(effect-map-flatten): `Effect.map` + `Effect.flatten` is the same as `Effect.flatMap` that expresses the same steps more directly.
*/
)
```
